## Highlights since 0.11.8

- **Full-text search across your papers.** Type in the Papers panel's search box to search the full text of the project's papers: results are ranked by relevance, each paper shows its matching lines with the words highlighted, and clicking a line opens the paper at that line. Chinese is supported, and the agent searches the same index.
- **Open Slide works with the Agent panel.** A presentation shows when the Lattice agent is editing the deck, and Open Slide's Apply comments, Draft a deck and Ask AI now open in the Agent panel.
- **See what the agent is doing.** The Agent panel shows what the current turn is working on.
